# CU-ID: arch
# CU-TYPE: ArchCU
# DTR-COORDINATES: 

Hexagonal architecture for the Scala Hypothesis Engine. Layer order DOMAIN, APPLICATION, INFRASTRUCTURE, CONTROL. Domain holds immutable models only. Application owns ports and services. Infrastructure provides adapters. Control performs DI wiring and CLI entry. No cross-layer imports: domain imports nothing from application/infrastructure/control; application imports domain only; infrastructure imports application and domain; control imports all. Dependencies are injected through constructors; no service locators. The ledger report is a read-only projection of ledger state built in application and encoded in control; it never decides an outcome. Severity: every CU is CRITICAL unless downgraded explicitly.

IMPLEMENTATION_STEPS:
1. Apply these rules to every file authored by this batch: domain at hypothesisengine/domain, application at hypothesisengine/application, infrastructure at hypothesisengine/infrastructure, control at hypothesisengine/control.

Prove: `grep -c 'package hypothesisengine' hypothesis-engine/src/main/scala/hypothesisengine/domain/Model.scala` prints 1.

Do NOT touch: hypothesis-engine/src/test/**, .LLMDD/**

Stop when: every authored source file sits in its layer package and no import crosses a layer boundary.

# CU-ID: legend
# CU-TYPE: LegendCU
# DTR-COORDINATES: 

LEGEND for feat-18. CU means Computational Unit. CU folder is the per-CU directory named after the cu id. COORDINATES.itr names the baseline DTR keys the CU touches. REQUIREMENTS.itr names the feature criteria the CU delivers. IMPLEMENTATION_STEPS.itr holds numbered steps, each with an exact file path, a complete fenced code block, a Prove line, a Do NOT touch list and a Stop when line. ACCEPTANCE.itr names the spec test ids with commands and expected results. Hypothesis is a candidate correctness claim carrying an Advisor-authored justification. Gate floor is the inclusive engine minimum of 0.85 for gate_probability_for_correctness. LedgerStageReport is the read-only per-stage projection of ledger state containing the hypothesis, its coordinates, justification, posterior, gate, gap, decision and cumulative StageDecision history. Stage is one engine invocation, numbered by the count of prior decision records plus one. Conversation record is the feature artifact holding verbatim report echoes. Report echo is the exact report block pasted into the design conversation. Verdict line is the GREEN_LIGHT, RED_LIGHT or ADVISOR_ACTION_REQUIRED line printed by the engine.

IMPLEMENTATION_STEPS:
1. Apply this legend when reading any CU frame in this batch.

Prove: `grep -c 'LedgerStageReport' .LLMDD/ITRS/feat-18-raise-hypothesis-gate-and-print-ledger/LEGEND.itr` prints 1.

Do NOT touch: hypothesis-engine/src/test/**, .LLMDD/spec-driven/**

Stop when: all terms used in CU frames are defined here.

REQUIREMENTS:
feat-18 Phase 2 criteria 13 and 14 (build portion): declare sbt-assembly, set the main class and a deterministic jar name, and assemble a single self-contained jar carrying every runtime dependency (sqlite-jdbc, circe) plus the ledger-schema.sql resource. The existing ensureLedger wiring MUST remain intact.

COORDINATES:
- FILE.hypothesis-engine/project/plugins.sbt
- FILE.hypothesis-engine/build.sbt

IMPLEMENTATION_STEPS:
1. Write the complete file `hypothesis-engine/project/plugins.sbt` to exactly:
```scala
libraryDependencies += "org.xerial" % "sqlite-jdbc" % "3.45.3.0"

addSbtPlugin("com.eed3si9n" % "sbt-assembly" % "2.3.1")
```
   Prove: `cd hypothesis-engine && sbt -batch "show assemblyMergeStrategy" >/dev/null 2>&1; echo $?` prints `0`.
   Do NOT touch: hypothesis-engine/src/**; hypothesis-engine/ledger.db; .gitignore
   Stop when: the assembly plugin resolves and `show assemblyMergeStrategy` exits 0.

2. Write the complete file `hypothesis-engine/build.sbt` to exactly:
```scala
ThisBuild / scalaVersion := "3.3.3"
ThisBuild / organization := "hypothesisengine"

lazy val schemaDdl: String =
  "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS hypotheses (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, statement TEXT, gate REAL, prior REAL, justification TEXT);" + "\n" +
  "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS coordinates (hypothesis_id TEXT, coordinate TEXT);" + "\n" +
  "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS experiments (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, hypothesis_id TEXT, definition TEXT, artifact_version TEXT);" + "\n" +
  "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS executions (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, hypothesis_id TEXT, experiment_id TEXT, artifact_version TEXT, command TEXT, revision TEXT, timeout_seconds INTEGER, exit_code INTEGER, stdout TEXT, stderr TEXT, duration_millis INTEGER, recorded_at TEXT);" + "\n" +
  "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS evidence (execution_id TEXT, hypothesis_id TEXT, passed INTEGER, detail TEXT);" + "\n" +
  "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS calculations (hypothesis_id TEXT, posterior REAL, calculated_at TEXT);" + "\n" +
  "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS decisions (hypothesis_id TEXT, decision TEXT, gate REAL, posterior REAL)"

lazy val cleanLedger = taskKey[Unit]("Reset the embedded ledger for a fresh start")
lazy val ensureLedger = taskKey[Unit]("Create ledger.db from the embedded schema when absent")

lazy val root = (project in file(".")).settings(
  name := "hypothesis-engine",
  libraryDependencies ++= Seq(
    "org.xerial" % "sqlite-jdbc" % "3.45.3.0",
    "org.scalatest" %% "scalatest" % "3.2.18" % Test,
    "io.circe" %% "circe-core" % "0.14.10",
    "io.circe" %% "circe-generic" % "0.14.10",
    "io.circe" %% "circe-parser" % "0.14.10"
  ),
  cleanLedger := {
    val fresh: String = sys.props.getOrElse("hypothesis-engine.ledger.fresh", "true")
    val db: java.io.File = baseDirectory.value / "ledger.db"
    val suffixes: Seq[String] = Seq("", "-wal", "-shm")
    suffixes.foreach { suffix: String =>
      val target: java.io.File = new java.io.File(db.getAbsolutePath + suffix)
      if (target.exists()) target.delete()
    }
    val schema: java.io.File = baseDirectory.value / "src/main/resources/ledger-schema.sql"
    sbt.IO.write(schema, schemaDdl)
    println("LEDGER_CLEANED fresh=" + fresh)
  },
  ensureLedger := {
    val db: java.io.File = baseDirectory.value / "ledger.db"
    if (db.exists()) {
      println("LEDGER_EXISTS " + db.getAbsolutePath)
    } else {
      Class.forName("org.sqlite.JDBC")
      val conn: java.sql.Connection =
        java.sql.DriverManager.getConnection("jdbc:sqlite:" + db.getAbsolutePath)
      try {
        val stmt: java.sql.Statement = conn.createStatement()
        try {
          schemaDdl.split(";").foreach { part: String =>
            if (part.trim.nonEmpty) stmt.execute(part)
          }
        } finally stmt.close()
        println("LEDGER_CREATED " + db.getAbsolutePath)
      } finally conn.close()
    }
  },
  Compile / compile := ((Compile / compile) dependsOn ensureLedger).value,

  Compile / mainClass := Some("hypothesisengine.control.Main"),
  assembly / assemblyJarName := "hypothesis-engine.jar",
  assembly / assemblyOutputPath := baseDirectory.value / "hypothesis-engine.jar",
  assembly / assemblyMergeStrategy := {
    case "META-INF/services/java.sql.Driver" => MergeStrategy.concat
    case PathList("META-INF", "MANIFEST.MF")   => MergeStrategy.discard
    case PathList("META-INF", "DEPENDENCIES")  => MergeStrategy.discard
    case PathList("META-INF", "LICENSE")       => MergeStrategy.discard
    case PathList("META-INF", "LICENSE.txt")   => MergeStrategy.discard
    case PathList("META-INF", "NOTICE")        => MergeStrategy.discard
    case PathList("META-INF", "NOTICE.txt")    => MergeStrategy.discard
    case PathList("META-INF", xs @ _*)         => MergeStrategy.first
    case _                                     => MergeStrategy.first
  }
)
```
   The `Compile / compile` dependsOn `ensureLedger` line is unchanged. The driver service file is concatenated so `java -jar` registers sqlite-jdbc in one classloader; manifest and license noise is discarded.
   Prove: `cd hypothesis-engine && sbt -batch assembly >/tmp/opencode/asm.log 2>&1; echo $?` prints `0`; then `test -f hypothesis-engine/hypothesis-engine.jar && unzip -l hypothesis-engine/hypothesis-engine.jar | grep -E 'org/sqlite/JDBC.class|ledger-schema.sql|hypothesisengine/control/Main.class'` lists all three entries.
   Do NOT touch: Main.scala, project/plugins.sbt (already set in step 1), .gitignore, any file under src/test/, ledger.db.
   Stop when: `hypothesis-engine/hypothesis-engine.jar` exists at the module root and contains Main.class, org/sqlite/JDBC.class and ledger-schema.sql.

ACCEPTANCE:
- TJ1 (criterion 13): `grep -c 'sbt-assembly' hypothesis-engine/project/plugins.sbt` prints 1; `grep -cE 'Compile / mainClass|assemblyJarName' hypothesis-engine/build.sbt` prints 2; `cd hypothesis-engine && sbt -batch assembly` exits 0.
- TJ2 (criterion 14, build half): `unzip -l hypothesis-engine/hypothesis-engine.jar` lists `hypothesisengine/control/Main.class`, `org/sqlite/JDBC.class` and `ledger-schema.sql`; `unzip -p hypothesis-engine/hypothesis-engine.jar META-INF/MANIFEST.MF | grep Main-Class` shows `hypothesisengine.control.Main`.

REQUIREMENTS:
feat-18 Phase 2 criterion 15: the engine reads an explicit ledger path from JVM property `hypothesis-engine.ledger.path` and passes it to `new SqliteLedger(path)`; the default stays `ledger.db` for source runs. No other behaviour changes.

COORDINATES:
- FILE.hypothesis-engine/src/main/scala/hypothesisengine/control/Main.scala

IMPLEMENTATION_STEPS:
1. Write the complete file `hypothesis-engine/src/main/scala/hypothesisengine/control/Main.scala` to exactly:
```scala
package hypothesisengine.control

import hypothesisengine.application.*
import hypothesisengine.domain.*
import hypothesisengine.infrastructure.*
import io.circe.Decoder
import io.circe.Encoder
import io.circe.parser.decode
import io.circe.syntax.*
import java.nio.file.{Files, Paths, StandardOpenOption}

object ReportJson:
  given Encoder[StageDecision] = Encoder.forProduct4("stage", "posterior", "gate", "decision")(value =>
    (value.stage, value.posterior, value.gate, value.decision))
  given Encoder[BreakpointView] = Encoder.forProduct3("coordinate", "execution_id", "detail")(value =>
    (value.coordinate, value.executionId, value.detail))
  given Encoder[LedgerStageReport] = Encoder.forProduct12(
    "stage", "hypothesis_id", "statement", "dtr_coordinates", "justification",
    "probability_for_correctness", "gate", "gap", "decision", "breakpoints",
    "fix", "history"
  )(value => (
    value.stage, value.hypothesisId, value.statement, value.dtrCoordinates, value.justification,
    value.probabilityForCorrectness, value.gate, value.gap, value.decision, value.breakpoints,
    value.fix, value.history
  ))

final class HypothesisEngine(runner: ProcessRunner, ledger: Ledger, clock: Clock):
  def execute(hypothesis: Hypothesis, definitions: Vector[ExperimentDefinition]): ExaminationOutcome =
    val priorHistory: Vector[StageDecision] = ledger.decisionHistory(hypothesis.id)
    val decision: Decision =
      LedgerValidator.requireAdmissible(hypothesis) match
        case Left(reason) => Decision.Blocked(reason)
        case Right(_) =>
          ledger.resetStageData(hypothesis.id)
          ledger.saveHypothesis(hypothesis)
          ledger.saveCoordinates(hypothesis.id, hypothesis.coordinates)
          ledger.saveExperiments(hypothesis.id, definitions)
          definitions.foreach { definition =>
            val raw: RawResult = runner.run(definition)
            ledger.saveRaw(raw)
            ResultNormalizer.validate(raw) match
              case Right(normalized) => ledger.saveNormalized(normalized)
              case Left(error) => System.err.println("REJECTED " + error)
          }
          LedgerValidator.requireComplete(ledger.missingFor(hypothesis, definitions)) match
            case Left(reason) =>
              val blocked: Decision = ExaminationGate.blocked(hypothesis, reason)
              ledger.saveDecision(hypothesis.id, blocked)
              blocked
            case Right(_) =>
              val results: Vector[(RawResult, NormalizedResult)] = ledger.resultsFor(hypothesis.id)
              val posterior: Double = BayesianEvaluator.update(hypothesis.prior, results.map((_._2)))
              ledger.saveCalculation(BayesianEvaluator.record(hypothesis.id, posterior, clock.now()))
              val decided: Decision = ExaminationGate.decide(hypothesis, posterior, results)
              ledger.saveDecision(hypothesis.id, decided)
              decided
    ExaminationOutcome(decision, StageReporter.build(hypothesis, decision, priorHistory))

object Main:
  given Decoder[HypothesisId] = Decoder.decodeString.map(HypothesisId.apply)
  given Decoder[DtrCoordinate] = Decoder.decodeString.map(DtrCoordinate.apply)
  given Decoder[Hypothesis] = Decoder.forProduct6(
    "id", "statement", "dtr_coordinates", "gate_probability_for_correctness", "prior", "justification"
  )(Hypothesis.apply)

  def main(args: Array[String]): Unit =
    if args.length < 2 then
      System.err.println("usage: Main <hypothesis.json> <experiments.jsonl>")
      System.exit(2)
    val hypothesisJson: String = new String(Files.readAllBytes(Paths.get(args(0))), "UTF-8")
    val hypothesis: Hypothesis = decode[Hypothesis](hypothesisJson).fold(
      error => throw new IllegalArgumentException(error.getMessage), identity)
    val definitions: Vector[ExperimentDefinition] = Files.readAllLines(Paths.get(args(1)).toAbsolutePath).toArray(new Array[String](0)).toVector
      .filter(_.trim.nonEmpty)
      .map { line =>
        ExperimentDefinitionCodec.parse(line).fold(
          error => throw new IllegalArgumentException(error), identity)
      }
    val clock: Clock = new SystemClock
    val ledgerPath: String = sys.props.getOrElse("hypothesis-engine.ledger.path", "ledger.db")
    val engine: HypothesisEngine = new HypothesisEngine(new ProcessAdapter(clock), new SqliteLedger(ledgerPath), clock)
    val outcome: ExaminationOutcome = engine.execute(hypothesis, definitions)
    import ReportJson.given
    val block: String = outcome.report.asJson.noSpaces
    println(block)
    val hypothesisPath: String = args(0)
    val reportPath: java.nio.file.Path = Paths.get(
      if hypothesisPath.endsWith(".hypotheses.json")
      then hypothesisPath.stripSuffix(".hypotheses.json") + ".ledger-report.jsonl"
      else hypothesisPath + ".ledger-report.jsonl"
    )
    Files.writeString(reportPath, block + System.lineSeparator, StandardOpenOption.CREATE, StandardOpenOption.APPEND)
    outcome.decision match
      case Decision.Green(_, posterior, gate) =>
        println("GREEN_LIGHT posterior=" + posterior + " gate=" + gate)
      case Decision.Red(_, posterior, gate, breakpoints, fix) =>
        println("RED_LIGHT posterior=" + posterior + " gate=" +
          " breakpoints=" + breakpoints.map(breakpoint => DtrCoordinate.value(breakpoint.coordinate)).mkString("|") +
          " fix=" + fix.description)
      case Decision.Blocked(reason) =>
        println("ADVISOR_ACTION_REQUIRED missing=" + reason.missing.mkString("|") +
          " corrections=" + reason.corrections.mkString("|"))
```
   The only change from baseline is the new `ledgerPath: String` binding and the `new SqliteLedger(ledgerPath)` constructor argument; the report path logic, codecs and verdict lines are byte-identical.
   Prove: `cd hypothesis-engine && sbt -batch compile >/tmp/opencode/compile-main.log 2>&1; echo $?` prints `0`; `grep -c 'hypothesis-engine.ledger.path' hypothesis-engine/src/main/scala/hypothesisengine/control/Main.scala` prints 1.
   Do NOT touch: hypothesis-engine/build.sbt; hypothesis-engine/project/plugins.sbt; .gitignore; hypothesis-engine/src/test/**; hypothesis-engine/src/main/scala/hypothesisengine/domain/**; hypothesis-engine/src/main/scala/hypothesisengine/application/**; hypothesis-engine/src/main/scala/hypothesisengine/infrastructure/**
   Stop when: Main.scala compiles and reads the property with default `ledger.db`.

ACCEPTANCE:
- TJ3 (criterion 15): exercised end-to-end by cu-004 (jar run with the property from a foreign cwd creates the ledger at exactly that path).
